claim: For the one-dimensional discrete-time quantum walk with initial state \(|\Psi_{\mathrm{in}}\rangle=(|0\rangle+i|1\rangle)|0\rangle/\sqrt2\) and coin \(U_{0,\theta,0}=\begin{pmatrix}\cos\theta&\sin\theta\\\sin\theta&-\cos\theta\end{pmatrix}\), \(0\le\theta\le\pi/2\), let \(H_n(\theta)\) be the Shannon entropy of the position distribution after \(n\) steps. At two steps, \[p_2(-2)=p_2(2)=\frac{\cos^2\theta}{2},\qquad p_2(0)=\sin^2\theta,\] so the unique maximizer is \(\theta_2^*=\arcsin(1/\sqrt3)\), where the three accessible positions are uniform and \(H_2=\log_2 3\). At three steps, \[p_3(-3)=p_3(3)=\frac{\cos^4\theta}{2},\qquad p_3(-1)=p_3(1)=\frac{1-\cos^4\theta}{2},\] so the unique maximizer is \(\theta_3^*=\arccos(2^{-1/4})\), where the four accessible positions are uniform and \(H_3=2\). Both angles are strictly below the Hadamard value \(\pi/4\). In particular \(H_2(\pi/4)=3/2<\log_2 3\) and \(H_3(\pi/4)=3-(3/4)\log_2 3<2\). At one step the position distribution is \((1/2,1/2)\) for every \(\theta\), so \(n=2\) is the earliest nontrivial strict counterexample to the published statement, later repeated as holding for any \(n\), that the Hadamard coin maximizes the position-measurement entropy. No claim is made about the large-time or asymptotic entropy optimum.

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; deterministic finite simulation is supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: Exact two- and three-step position-entropy maximizers and the earliest strict counterexample to the published finite-time Hadamard-maximality statement.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The walk model, coin family, symmetric initial state, large-step numerical entropy discussion, and later finite-time monotonicity statement are credited to the cited sources.

scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies position-measurement entropy only at one, two, and three steps for the cited symmetric initial state and coin family.
It does not claim that the Hadamard coin is suboptimal at large time or in an asymptotic entropy problem.
It concerns position Shannon entropy, not coin-position entanglement entropy.
An equivalent short-time observation may exist under a different coin-angle convention or in unindexed literature.
title: Exact short-time entropy maximizers in the symmetric SU(2) quantum walk
